review.management_type_reason: RHS・MBG・Walters・stauden.de（いずれも品種）: こぼれ種を防ぐ・花を増やすために花がらを摘む、咲き終わった茎を株元の葉まで切る。広がり方は non-invasive と明記で E ではない
review.management_type_quote: Remove faded flowers to encourage more buds, also to prevent plants from self seeding all over.
review.heat_muggy_west_evidence:
[おぎはら/品種] 耐暑性；中
[おぎはら楽天/品種] 耐湿性: 普 通 向きますが高温多湿は嫌います（蒸れ 中 相当）
[MBG/品種] Best performance occurs in cool summer climates where night temperatures consistently dip below 70F degrees, which unfortunately is a cultural preference that does not fit the profile of a typical St.
[食い違い] 欧米の文献（品種の記述）は 弱 相当。おぎはら植物園の値を採った
[RHS/品種] Aspect: South-facing or North-facing or West-facing or East-facing
review.spread_evidence:
[こぼれ種 1／MBG・品種] In optimum growing conditions, plants will spread by stolons and/or self-seeding in a non-invasive manner to form colonies.
[地下茎 2／MBG・品種] Noteworthy Characteristics Astrantia major , commonly called greater masterwort, is an upright, umbelliferous, stoloniferous, herbaceous perennial (carrot family) that is native to mountain meadows, grasslands, woodland
review.silhouette_evidence: [MBG・品種] 'Roma' is an upright, umbelliferous, stoloniferous, clump-forming masterwort that typically grows to 20-25” tall.
